story: From Vanderbijlpark it runs 375 km to Vanderbijlpark; allow about 6 h 28 of riding. The stops in between: Walter Sisulu Square, Liliesleaf, 16 June 1976 - The Streets of Orlando West and Sterkfontein. The highest point is about 1,650 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
